plugins.name: clear-prep
plugins.description: Run /clear-prep before /clear to back up durable memory and in-progress session state; a bundled hook then auto-restores the handoff note right after.

plugins.name: codex-direct-review
plugins.description: Run a Codex CLI review as a fresh, one-shot process (generic codex exec with a hand-built prompt) — no shared broker, no silent failures.

plugins.name: codex-stream-review
plugins.description: Experimental: stream live Codex review progress via a persisted thread's rollout file, with multi-round follow-up via codex exec resume — no diff re-send. Separate from codex-direct-review.
